'Full Band Crescendo' was generated by SounDoer with Suno on a paid subscription
and is owned by SounDoer. All rights reserved.

full-band-crescendo.flac is a lossless FLAC of the generated stereo WAV
(48 kHz, 16-bit, 252.5 s); the samples are unchanged. The homepage fixtures apply
only a constant gain to it, and the multichannel fixtures are mixed from the same
generation's Suno stems.

The audio is licensed separately from the repository's software and is not covered
by the repository's software licence.
